provenance.adaptation: one600sRD;600 native1s joint offset/size/read-write frequency slices;max;no per-second quota;no Zipf
provenance.file_size_rule: one container; each selected key owns ceil(full-window observed maximum endpoint/4MiB) exclusive objects
provenance.key_identity: block_id; rs_shard_id=0 is a CSV compatibility placeholder only
provenance.limitation: selected records already4KiB aligned; finite max-rate samples and source-rate variation still affect whole-run frequencies and object coverage
provenance.object_mapping: (key,object_index) bijects to container object; each key starts at4MiB boundary and owns whole objects
provenance.operation_mapping: GET becomes read;PUT becomes write;retain every selected original record
provenance.preparation: standard full container format; each key owns whole4MiB objects; runtime never accesses alignment padding

selection.hash_order: unsigned 64-bit ascending; input keys unique, SplitMix64 bijective

provenance.source_boundary_policy: fixed full source boundaries,not selected-key min/max
provenance.source_dataset_role: data warehouse,as identified in Baleen FAST2024 AppendixA.8
provenance.source_file_size_rule: observed full-window maximum endpoint per key;CSV file_bytes rounded to2MiB for compatibility
provenance.timeline: affine map fixed full Region2 nanosecond boundaries to600s;retain every record of the selected keys;sample at preIO;no original event-order replay
provenance.timestamp_label_note: official path says201910;original timestamps fall inSeptember2019;retain both unchanged
provenance.transfer_alignment: 4KiB covering alignment;all selected source requests already aligned,so zero requests change
